g.text: The bias supplies current; a photon-induced resistance diverts current into the RF readout.
The choke supplies DC bias; the coupling capacitor passes the pulse to the readout.
The full load depends on frequency and includes the 20 Ω return path.
Values shown: nominal 30 pF model configuration. The meander is a detector symbol, not a scale drawing.
